scope: Public Svelte component and pattern exports from ts/src/components/index.ts and ts/src/patterns/index.ts. Utility and type-only exports are intentionally excluded from this batch.

decision.poodle_gap_rule: If a migration reveals missing primitive or generic composite behavior, add it to Poodle instead of preserving the gap inside a long-lived Underlay wrapper.
decision.poodle_ergonomics_rule: If a surface clearly belongs in a design system but Poodle's current API, styling constraints, or interaction model make common application workflows awkward, extend Poodle rather than retaining a second canonical Underlay implementation.

candidate_for_poodle_when: The surface is domain-neutral and can be named without Underlay portfolio nouns or workflow assumptions.
The surface represents a stable component contract rather than a product page assembly.
The surface is likely to recur across multiple apps and runtime targets.
The surface primarily expresses UI structure, interaction, accessibility, and theming.
The surface remains a Poodle candidate even when it needs contract, behavior, or styling improvement to fit everyday workflows cleanly.
keep_in_underlay_when: The surface is primarily a website shell, admin shell, operational flow, or product-oriented page composition.
The surface binds together generic parts with portfolio-specific workflow logic.
The surface carries auth-policy, recovery-flow, or other orchestration assumptions that are not clean design-system contracts.

wave_045_reassessment.purpose: Post-g01.042 reassessment of the still-exported Underlay Svelte surface. This section tracks the remaining public exports that should be removed or migrated in the follow-on contraction wave, distinct from the historical g01.042 migration record below.
notes: These groups are the strict next-wave review set after g01.042 and g01.044. They reflect the live public export list rather than only the already-executed retirements.
Batch 45.2 already removed the generic detail/layout wrapper family from the public Underlay surface. The remaining tail is now concentrated in the inline-list and stats/grid wrappers.
`ListCard` and `FormActions` were the first two broad retained-surface reassessment targets. `ListCard` needed capability work first; `FormActions` followed once the card wave settled.

The `ListCard` review confirmed four real remaining gaps against current Poodle `ListCard`: route-style `href` navigation, compact reorder treatment with drag handles, card-level selection mode, and the existing action-trigger composition pattern.

`AudioPlayer` and `AudioEmbed` are now retired from the public Underlay surface. Direct shared audio playback belongs to Poodle `AudioPlayer`, and the only former `AudioEmbed` callers in Dairy now compose Poodle `AudioPlayer` and `EmbedPreview` directly over an app-owned direct-audio utility instead of preserving a shared Underlay wrapper.

`CardRadioGroup` is now retired from the public Underlay surface. The remaining live caller in Dairy now uses direct Poodle `CardRadioGroup` with caller-owned icon and tone composition instead of keeping a second shared card-choice wrapper.
`DateRange` is now internalized to shared formatter exports only. The component form had no live callers, while the formatter helpers still serve app list-card and schedule-label text generation.

`DurationInput` is now retired from the public Underlay surface. The last live callers in Dairy now use direct Poodle `DurationInput` with caller-owned hidden inputs and duration-string conversion instead of preserving a second segmented-duration wrapper.

`RangeSlider` is now retired from the public Underlay surface. The live Dairy caller set turned out to be a discrete labeled single-value difficulty scale, so those forms now use direct Poodle `Slider` with caller-owned labels instead of preserving a second shared Underlay wrapper or forcing a false Poodle `RangeSlider` parity story.

`ColorPicker` and `TextArea` are now retired from the public Underlay surface. Neither retained a live consumer-app caller family once the active forms moved to direct Poodle primitives, so keeping those same-name wrappers exported was only stale surface area.
`VideoPlayer` is now retired from the public Underlay surface. It no longer had live consumer-app callers, and direct shared video playback belongs to Poodle `VideoPlayer`.

`MarkdownEditor` is no longer part of shared Underlay `components`. The EasyMDE-backed editor runtime and selection-context contract now live under `nightfire/markup`, where the only remaining retained callers actually belong.

`Badge`, `Pill`, and `Switch` are now retired from the public Underlay surface. Their live consumer-app caller families are gone, and direct Poodle `Pill` and `Switch` now carry the real shared successor behavior without a second Underlay wrapper layer.

`Select` is no longer part of shared Underlay `components`. The only remaining retained callers were Nightfire editors, so the richer native-select contract now lives under `nightfire` ownership instead of posing as a shared widget.

`TimeAgo` is now retired from the public Underlay surface. The broad remaining caller family in Acowtancy Dairy and retained Underlay docs/examples now uses direct Poodle `TimeAgo`, so keeping a second shared relative-time wrapper exported no longer adds contract value.

`InlineListCard` and `InlineListItem` are now retired from the public Underlay surface. The full caller family across Dairy and the admin media-detail pages collapsed onto direct Poodle `Card` composition with caller-owned rows and actions, so the old shared wrapper pair no longer adds honest contract value.

`DataTable` is now retired from the public Underlay surface. g01.047 moved the richer generic table runtime into Poodle `DataTable`, migrated the active app and retained-shell caller family, and removed the old Underlay table wrapper plus its helper/test files.

`Pagination` is now retired from the public Underlay surface. Poodle `Pagination` now carries the generic controller-driven contract the live caller family needed, including limit selector, info text, simple/full variants, and scroll-target behavior.

`ReorderableList` remains a deliberate retained hold for now. The latest g01.046 reassessment confirmed that even after the `ListCard` migration wave, the active caller family still depends on a workflow-first shell over reordering: batch-submit/cancel flow, dirty-state handling, async error presentation, long-list warnings, optional windowed reorder mode, and richer keyboard/live-region guidance that current Poodle `ReorderableList` does not aim to own.

`OrderBy` remains a deliberate retained Underlay surface for now. The latest g01.046 reassessment confirmed that the active admin caller family still depends on a materially broader sort-builder contract than current Poodle `OrderBy`: ordered multi-field sorting with add/remove, per-field direction, drag reordering, compact trigger summaries, and URL round-tripping for sort arrays.

`ListCard` is now retired from the public Underlay surface. The g01.046 reassessment pushed the remaining generic card behavior into Poodle `ListCard`, migrated the live caller family, and moved retained Underlay shells like `AutonomousList` onto direct Poodle card composition.

`FormActions` is now retired from the public Underlay surface. Poodle `FormActions` now owns the responsive inline-danger versus collapsed-danger-menu behavior and `dangerItems` callback wiring that previously blocked migration, and the live consumer-app caller family is off the old Underlay wrapper.
`Drawer` and `SegmentedControl` are now retired from the public Underlay surface. Neither had live consumer-app callers once the active admin guides moved to direct Poodle usage.
`Code` is now retired from the public Underlay surface. The remaining live app and retained-shell callers now use direct Poodle `Code` with explicit `inline` and `source` props.
`Skeleton` is now internal-only in Underlay. There are no live consumer-app callers left, and low-level manual loading composition should use direct Poodle `Skeleton` instead.

`ToastHost` and `PageLoading` are both now retired from the public Underlay surface. Poodle owns the final generic runtime host and inline page-state loading contracts that were still left in Underlay after the earlier reassessment wave.

`DataSkeleton` is now retired from the public Underlay surface. It had no live consumer-app or internal runtime callers left, so repeated loading layouts should now compose directly from Poodle `Skeleton` presets in the consuming app instead of depending on a second shared wrapper and preset registry.

`ProgressBar` is now retired from the public Underlay surface. Poodle `Progress` now carries the only missing shared behavior, size-aware bar height, and the live admin plus Acowtancy callers use it directly.
Utility and type-only exports remain intentionally out of scope for this surface reassessment.
